finding: For the 600-cell circulant G6 cyclic-unitary ansatz, exact Cauchy–Binet positivity, spectral semicircle, self-plane positivity and row-imbalance branch certificates reduce 78 initial simple-spectrum classes to 13, all fields and phases. A separate exact cyclotomic replay checked all 32 imbalance branches and 576 strict signs. The direct determinant-zero relaxation remains satisfiable at some positive balanced population in each of the earlier 40 classes, so self/row constraints are essential. All results are unreviewed.
remaining_gap: The thirteen cyclic classes still have continuous Gram equations, and the noncyclic complement and remaining 25 QLS cells remain open. No unrestricted G6 or 1RQLS10 existence or nonexistence is claimed.
next_action: Seek rank-one cross-kernel/self-orthogonality obstructions or a concrete positive witness in the thirteen residual classes; preserve independent-review boundaries.
